role: Kansas Department of Economic Development, Planning Division
summary: Karen Unsworth, representing the Planning Division of the Kansas Department of Economic Development, expressed straightforward support for both the draft environmental impact statement and the proposed regulations governing off-road vehicle use on public lands. Her comment was brief and unequivocal, raising no objections or concerns.

July 6, 1972
Return to Budget Division, Dept. of Administration lst Floor, Statehouse, Topeka, Kansas 66612
The enclosed proposal has been submitted to the Budget Division under its clearinghouse responsibilities described in Bureau of the Budget Circular A-95. Your review of this proposal as it affects the interest of the state will be appreciated. Your appropriate comments concerning the proposal should be submitted to the Budget Division no later than the date specified above.
Comments filed on a proposal may include: (1) the extent to which the project is consistent with or contributes to the fulfillment of comprehensive planning within the state; (2) how the proposal relates to state objectives; and (3) the effect of the proposal on your agency's activities.
COMMENTS:
The Planning Division agrees with this environmental statement and
with the proposed regulations.
Karen I. Un worth for Signature
